data.body: Closure note (user-authorized): This ticket is a reconciler FIELD-PROBE orphan (tag imported:reconciler-bootstrap), not a code defect — a synthetic Jira field-mapping probe left behind when a prior probe run's Phase 8 cleanup did not complete (commit f4ed5eca23 flagged jira-dig-5281..5289 as 33 abandoned FIELD-PROBE tickets). Caveat: closing a reconciler-sourced ticket can interact with the level-triggered Jira reconciler. If this ticket re-materializes or re-opens on the next sync, that is a direct signal a LIVE Jira counterpart still exists — in which case reopen and route the systemic cleanup through bug 555b (local-ticket delete fails on prev_snapshot.json merge conflict -> FIELD-PROBE orphans). If it stays closed, no live counterpart existed and closure is final.
